description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three question difficulty levels: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, as well as a Total accuracy score. The horizontal axis displays the question difficulty categories—Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total—in that order, with no specified scale type. The vertical axis, labeled “Execution Accuracy,” represents values on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10, and units expressed as percentages. For each difficulty level, there are two bars representing the two models: NatSQL is represented by a light blue bar, and TA-SQL is represented by a dark blue bar. For the “Simple” category, the NatSQL bar reaches approximately 60.21% and the TA-SQL bar reaches 63.14%. In the “Moderate” category, the NatSQL bar reaches approximately 39.64% and the TA-SQL bar reaches 48.60%. For “Challenging” questions, the NatSQL bar reaches 32.32% and the TA-SQL bar reaches 36.11%. Finally, for the “Total” accuracy, the NatSQL bar reaches 51.35% and the TA-SQL bar reaches 56.19%. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each difficulty level, allowing for a visual comparison of the two models’ performance within each category, and are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
